title: I Ran the Same Product Research in Claude Code and Claude Design
description: A hands-on comparative experiment testing how Anthropic's Claude tools handle product research workflows, revealing surprising differences in approach and output quality. This timely analysis helps designers understand when and how to leverage AI tools effectively in their research processes.

title: How Korea & Japan turned ordering food into a UX masterclass
description: An in-depth case study examining how self-ordering kiosks and tablets in Asian markets have become exemplars of intuitive interaction design. This practical analysis reveals globally applicable principles for designing conversational and efficient user experiences in high-stakes real-world environments.

title: Why 10,000 experiments work better than 10,000 hours for designers
description: Using Airbnb's bold redesign strategy as a case study, this essay challenges the traditional 10,000-hour mastery model and argues that rapid experimentation accelerates design growth more effectively. Essential reading for teams looking to break free from incremental optimization and unlock breakthrough innovation.

title: Own the room, or leave it
description: A candid essay about reclaiming design authority in meetings by unlearning passive communication habits that undermine designer credibility. This reflection offers practical mindset shifts for designers seeking to lead with confidence and ensure their expertise shapes decisions.

title: Designing for the proxy
description: An insightful exploration of how AI intermediaries are reshaping the design-to-user pipeline, fundamentally changing who experiences our interfaces first. This forward-thinking piece prepares designers to think beyond human readers and optimize for algorithmic interpretation.

title: Gap Decorations Are Now Available, Here's What's New
description: With CSS gap decorations now fully supported in modern browsers, this guide breaks down a powerful new styling capability that gives designers precise control over spacing visual elements. A practical tool update with immediate applicability for frontend implementation.

title: Anthropeum
description: An innovative daily game mechanic that gamifies cultural literacy by challenging players to identify artifacts and their origins across human civilizations. A compelling example of how thoughtful interaction design can transform education into engaging, habit-forming experiences.

title: The computer that helped win World War II
description: A historical deep-dive into Colossus, the pioneering computer that cracked Nazi encryption and shaped computing history, reminding designers that UX decisions have always had real-world stakes. Essential context for understanding how interface design has influenced the trajectory of human events.
